mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 2.0% signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers anticipated Federal Reserve rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) indicate a monetary policy response to economic weakness, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate fiscal stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle recovery regimes, month-over-month PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating labor market strength that precedes corporate earnings expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% during early-cycle recovery periods.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) compresses equity risk premiums as the Federal Reserve is expected to implement accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 550.0 thousand units signal robust residential construction activity that precedes broader economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST exceeds 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery regimes, month-over-month RSAFS growth exceeding 0.3% indicates strengthening consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months meeting the trigger condition during post-recession recovery periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent month-over-month INDPRO growth exceeding 0.5% and quarter-over-quarter GDPC1 growth exceeding 0.5% signal robust industrial production and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate sustained corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters meeting the trigger condition.
